description.value: Deol Family Estate Winery is a family-owned estate operation on an 18-acre vineyard in North Cowichan, growing vines since 1984 and producing wines entirely from estate-grown grapes—Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir, Marechal Foch, and Gamay Noir—with all steps from harvest to bottling done on-site. Touring cyclists can stop at the tasting room and wine shop, and a patio picnic area with tables invites visitors to bring their own lunch and linger over a glass amid vineyard scenery. The winery also sells wines online and at the Cowichan Farmer's Market.
